lines.text: Ooh yeah… I know a few
La-la, uh-huh
[Verse 1] (all 8–9)
I know “damn” when the coffee’s too hot
I know “hell” when the signal drops
I know “shit” when I stub my toe
I know “fuck” when the whole day goes
I save “bitch” for the mirror sometimes
Just me and my face having a time
I know the soft ones and the heavy ones too
But only when the moment feels true
[Pre-Chorus] (all 7–8)
I don’t drop them every line
I’m a lady most of the time
But when the pressure hits just right
These little words feel so damn fine
[Chorus] (consistent 8–9 pattern)
My favorite word is “fuck,” no contest
It works for the good and the rest
Say it soft when you make me melt
Scream it loud when I need some help
One little word, so many moods
Angry, happy, shocked, in the mood
Yeah, my favorite word is “fuck”
Nothing else packs quite that much
[Verse 2] (all 8–9)
I use “damn” when the beat feels good
I use “hell yeah” when I’m in the mood
I use “shit” when I’m running late
But “fuck” is the one that seals my fate
Traffic jam, I say “fuck”
Perfect kiss, I say “fuck”
Forgot my keys, I say “fuck”
You looking like that? I say “fuck”
I don’t drop them every line
I’m a lady most of the time
But when the pressure hits just right
These little words feel so damn fine
My favorite word is “fuck,” no contest
It works for the good and the rest
Say it soft when you make me melt
Scream it loud when I need some help
One little word, so many moods
Angry, happy, shocked, in the mood
Yeah, my favorite word is “fuck”
Nothing else packs quite that much
[Bridge] (spoken-sung, kept short)
People say watch your language, girl
I just smile and give a little swirl
Some words are tools, some words are toys
This one’s my favorite little noise
[Final Chorus] (slightly bigger, still even)
My favorite word is “fuck,” no contest
It works for the good and the rest
Say it soft when you make me melt
Scream it loud when I need some help
One little word, so many moods
Angry, happy, shocked, in the mood
Yeah, my favorite word is “fuck”
Nothing else packs quite that much
So if you hear me say it, don’t be shocked
It’s just my favorite word… unlocked
Fuck… yeah…
